name: @bom-editor/demo
description: Vanilla browser workbench for the F3 10K BOM editor scenario.

scripts.build:dependencies: pnpm --filter @qkplm/bom-editor build && pnpm --filter @bom-editor/benchmark-fixtures build && pnpm --filter @qkplm/bom-editor-react build && pnpm --filter @qkplm/bom-editor-vue build && pnpm --filter @qkplm/bom-editor-umd build
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:dependencies && pnpm run build && node scripts/serve.mjs
